<!DOCTYPE root [
  <!ELEMENT root (child)*>
  <!ELEMENT child (#PCDATA)>
  <!ENTITY % pe " <!ENTITY ent 'resolved-pe'> ">
  %pe;
  <!NOTATION png SYSTEM "image/png">
  <!ENTITY ext SYSTEM "logo.png" NDATA png>
]>
<?xml-stylesheet type="text/xsl" href="transform.xsl"?>
<root xmlns="http://example.com/ns1" xmlns:ns2="http://example.com/ns2" ns2:id="root0">
  <!-- Leading structural comment before CDATA and entities -->
  <ns2:child>
    <![CDATA[
      CDATA block containing markup-like text: <child>&ent;</child>
    ]]>
  </ns2:child>
  <child>&ent;</child>
</root>

<!DOCTYPE archive [
  <!ELEMENT archive (item)*>
  <!ELEMENT item (#PCDATA)>
  <!ENTITY base "BaseEntity">
  <!ENTITY compound "&base;-Extended">
  <!NOTATION pdf SYSTEM "application/pdf">
  <!ENTITY doc SYSTEM "manual.pdf" NDATA pdf>
  <!ENTITY % ext_pe "<!ELEMENT data (#PCDATA)>">
  %ext_pe;
]>
<?xml-app-info status="active" version="2.0"?>
<archive xmlns="http://schemas.example.org/archive" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">
  <!-- Comment 1: Documenting namespace and schema location -->
  <item xlink:type="simple">
    <![CDATA[
      Some raw CDATA payload with entities &compound; inside.
    ]]>
  </item>
  <item>Value: &compound;</item>
</archive>

]>
<?xml-log level="debug" target="stdout"?>
<inventory xmlns="http://example.org/inventory" xmlns:inv="http://example.org/inventory/sub">

  <inv:stock inv:category="primary">
    <![CDATA[
      CDATA section with embedded tags: <inv:stock>&itemB;</inv:stock>
    ]]>
  </inv:stock>
  <stock>&internal-macro;</stock>
</inventory>

    ]]>
  </entry>
  <entry code="e2">&e-secondary;</entry>
</registry>
